newsitem.title: EGYPT: Arafat arrives in Cairo after Mubarak talks.
newsitem.headline: Arafat arrives in Cairo after Mubarak talks.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat arrived in Cairo on Monday after talks with Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak on whether they should go along with U.S. President Bill Clinton's plans for a Middle East summit.
"I received an invitation from His Excellency President Clinton and I sent him my reply," Arafat told reporters.
Asked what his reply was, he said: "I can't say before he receives the reply...The important thing is how to implement accurately what has been agreed upon (with Israel)."
Arafat and Mubarak met for more than two hours in the northwest Egyptian town of Burg al-Arab.
Palestinian officials say Arafat and Mubarak have asked the United States to postpone the summit but in Washington the U.S. State Department said it expected Arafat to come this week.

The Palestinian officials said Arafat would fly from Cairo to Brussels or Luxembourg in the mid-afternoon to discuss the Washington summit on Monday evening with the Troika of European Union foreign ministers.
